originalScoringFiles: SHA-256 provenance in motion-qa-provenance.json; original formulas, thresholds and GLB sampler unchanged.
independentContactMeasurement: Actual final GLB FK binding/toe/heel markers compared in full 3D against the authored equipment trajectory at 120Hz and all declared samples. Intended travel is reported separately; original footSliding values are retained unmodified.
independentGeometryMeasurement: All actual weighted skin and equipment vertices at each 30Hz source sample; all exact rigid-foot vertices and equipment vertices at 120Hz.
independentC1Measurement: Shared per-second cubic tangents at internal keys; source end to bridge start and bridge end to actor-rebased target start, including translation and heading offsets, quaternion values and normalized derivatives.
negativeControls: 3cm lateral supported Root shift must fail contact
0.1 outgoing cubic tangent perturbation must fail C1
3cm final Hips shift must fail loop closure
limitations: Original motion-qa-v1 score is an engineering screening heuristic, not an artistic or biomechanical certification.
Contact references declare authoring intent; the independent reader measures final decoded transforms and does not infer physics.
Full weighted body geometry is sampled at30Hz; ski and equipment geometry are sampled at120Hz.
Playback and final rendered sheets are checked separately; this does not measure a physical phone.
constantHoldEncoding: A static CUBICSPLINE channel may contain only its 0/duration endpoints, equal within1e-7, with exactly zero tangents; all changing channels preserve every30Hz sample. Playback and QA sample holds at30/120Hz.
